auth_details: Username query parameter (username=YOUR_USERNAME); free GeoNames account required; enable free web services on the account page. No separate API key is issued.
paid_plans: Premium Web Services: Best Availability (from 250€/yr) and Best Price (from 40€/yr); credit packs valid 1 year. Details: https://www.geonames.org/commercial-webservices.html
rate_limits: Free: 1000 credits/hour and 10000 credits/day; commercial Premium plans have higher published limits
resolution_notes: auth: auditor right—docs require username param, not an API key (https://www.geonames.org/export/web-services.html). free_tier_limits & rate_limits: auditor right—official free limits are 10k credits/day and 1000/hour, not 20k (https://www.geonames.org/export/). paid_plans: auditor right—Premium Best Availability/Best Price plans published (https://www.geonames.org/commercial-webservices.html). example.request: auditor right—placeholder must be YOUR_USERNAME (same web-services docs).
